Hi Priyom,

Quick intro — I'm Nora on the HelixCloud partnerships team. We're evaluating marketplace co-sell for a new managed model offering and would like to enroll in the AWS ACE program. Our AWS rep suggested we reach Redwood to understand ACE registration steps and pair PDM/PSM for the opportunity.

High level:
- We expect an initial pilot with a 3-month trial for 50 engineers.
- Timeline: kickoff in early October, procurement & contracts targeted end of Oct.

Can you confirm who at Redwood handles ACE intake and whether you need any security artifacts from us up front?

Thanks,

Nora — thanks for the note and congrats on the pilot timeline. Looping in Kimberly (PDM) and Karthik (PSM) who will partner through the ACE intake and co-sell readiness. A few quick asks to speed registration:

1) Please confirm the AWS Account ID you plan to use for the ACE listing.
2) Any compliance documents (SOC 2 report, encryption details) you can share now will accelerate review.
3) Procurement contact for contract/ordering (cc if possible).

Proposed next steps:
- Quick 30-min sync this week for intake + roles pairing.
- Kimberly/Karthik will produce a short intake runbook and checklist for AWS.

I can host the call — are you available Wed 9/16 10:00am PT or Thu 9/17 2:00pm PT?

Best,
